name: Coconut Lagoon (CGH Earth)
summary: Coconut Lagoon is a CGH Earth resort on Vembanad Lake at Kumarakom, reached by boat. Its cottages are traditional Kerala tharavad houses moved from elsewhere in central Kerala and rebuilt on the estate, and it has its own Ayurveda centre.
highlights: On Vembanad Lake, reached by a short boat ride
Traditional Kerala tharavad houses dismantled elsewhere and reassembled on the estate
Run by CGH Earth, a Kerala hotel group
